paragraphs.text: He returns to the genealogy of David, to show that Christ came from his stock.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Who in 2Sa 3:3 is called Chileab, born of her that was Nabal's wife the Carmelite.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: Called also Bathsheba the daughter of Eliam: for they gave them various names.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Elishama, or Elishua, 2Sa 5:15 and Eliphelet died, and David named those sons who were born next by the same names; in the book of kings his living children are mentioned and here both they that were alive and dead.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: So called because he was preferred for the royal dignity before his brother Jehoiakim who was the elder.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Matthew says that Zerubbabel was the son of Shealtiel, meaning that he was his nephew according to the Hebrew speech: for he was Pedaiah's son.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: So that Shemaiah was Shechaniah's natural son, and the other five his nephews and in all there were six.
paragraphs.label: g
